Thank you to all the participants for joining the tournament.
We had guest from Osijek Croatia making this tournament international.
Although we planed to have +10min per elimination extension finales were done in less then 2h mark.

The final seating was as follows:
Miloš Krstić (99 Problems)
Dušan Kosanović(Nefertiti variant - Stelth Bleed)
Milan Popović (Rafael de Corazon variant - Bleed Toolbox)
Nikica Novaković(Alexandra variant - Bleed Toolbox)
Višnja Ilić (Magaji vote variant - Politics)

Finales started off with fast removal of Milan Popović. As Rafale was left in locked state by Alexandra, he had no defenses against Dušan. The rest of the game was marked with slow Death of Nikica, as he struggled to maintain his position with Nefertiti bleed on his neck. Life boon was deployed in order to save Nikica, but alas, his end was foreseen. While Višnja was protected with Protected Resources Miloš had time to remove the Advantage Dušan acuminated, leaving us with expected domination of Emerald Legionnaire.
